name: foliage_field
title: Foliage Field, the NextGeo total against Nanite (GN-7; GN-13's Foliage Field half)

lines.name: Foliage Field NextGeo total: cull, raster, voxels and wind (N6)
lines.reason: Provisional UE group: the four GPU columns that appear in the capture only when the meshes are Nanite (a names-only comparison with the same map's meshes imported without Nanite, on the RTX 4080 SUPER machine in game mode); Nanite's virtual shadow map raster runs inside GPU/ShadowDepths with the rest of the shadow work and is left out. The settings record names the final columns (plan §23.5). The GodotNext group is not defined: the generated PN scene carries no NextGeo virtual geometry (its meshes are procedural ArrayMeshes, and NextGeo builds virtual geometry only at import), and the PN features this line measures are not built yet, so a GodotNext timing run of it has no NextGeo cull or raster column. The UE map draws the field's meshes as Nanite instanced static meshes with their masked materials (the settings record's NextGeo rows); the Nanite Foliage project setting (Assemblies, Voxels, Dynamic Wind) is off in the shared comparison project, and the scene has no wind and no voxel or assembly content that GodotNext renders, so the UE group is the Nanite passes of the plain field until the lead decides on that setting.

lines.name: Render-thread CPU, Foliage Field (GN-13 adds Dense City)
lines.reason: GN-13 judges the render-thread time of Dense City and Foliage Field together (plan §21.4.3); this set records the Foliage Field half, and the sum across the two sets (Dense City is #231's port) is not defined in the harness yet. The GodotNext render-thread column group is not defined yet either.
